chapter_logline: At the drowned node beneath the weir, Sigrid must navigate by current and echo while an injured Soren holds a failing gate long enough for her to redraw the route.

identity_contract.SOREN: clearly fictional mature adult; light-brown to dark-blond short-to-medium wavy swept-back hair, never black or bright blond; pale oatmeal work coat with quilted shoulder reinforcement
identity_contract.SIGRID: clearly fictional mature adult; dark-brown to near-black hair in compact low bun or practical braid, never blond or loose red curls; dark blue-brown plaid secured weather cape
identity_contract.TAMSIN_REEVE: clearly fictional adult courier-cartographer; practical non-sexualized field clothing; remains sheltered at the farmhouse after CH08 panel one
